text:
ria: Quick: scheduling quant-kernel v5.2-rc1 canary tonight 01:10 PT. Proposed plan: 4% initial -> 12% over 15m. Pin-ttl 90m. Rollback policy: partial drain on anomalous hosts; full rollback if >3% traffic impacted or persistent p95>180ms for 10m. Agree?

samir: Fine but add rule: if any host hits cgroup OOM twice within 30m, drain it and mark as 'suspect'. Also fallback image v5.1-quant should be warm in the same pool.

jon: Smoke checklist: run ./ci/smoke_canary.sh --suite quick; verify p95, kv_hit, cpu_steal. Acceptance: p95 <=130ms and errors <0.7%. Will run after kickoff.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued rollout release/quant-v5.2-rc1 -> runtime-canary. Targets: ~16 hosts (~4%). pin-ttl=90m. Link: https://deploy.redwood/rollouts/6555550000

ria: Also request that deploy-bot attaches auto-throttle: reduce to 50% if cpu_steal>12% or p95 delta >30% vs baseline.

sre-marta: I'll add alerts and watch. Oncall will tone in at start + 20m. Also will create a temporary dashboard focused on p95 and kv_miss.

lucy: Draft release note: "v5.2-rc1: tiled matmul improvements, experimental quant paths; opt-in only. Monitor for allocation regressions." Keeping cautious language.

jon: Starting smoke now.

(6m) jon: Smoke results: p95=122ms, errors=0.2%, kv_hit steady. No OOM. Posting trace https://perf.redwood/trace/6555550000

ria: Ramp to 8% then 12% if health holds.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramping to 8% now.

(9m) samir: Seeing one host (canary-11) show a spike in anon memory allocations then recover. Not OOM. Recommend draining canary-11 and shifting its traffic to v5.1-quant while we debug.

ria: Do the partial drain. deploy-bot, drain canary-11 and fallback to v5.1-quant for its slice. Notify infra to collect heap profiles.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: drain initiated for host canary-11. Traffic reassigned to v5.1-quant. Notifying infra and tagging incident.

(12m) jon: After drain: group p95=125ms, kv_hit stable, errors 0.25%. No other anomalies.

sre-marta: Oncall watching. I've pinned a note in the dashboard about the drained host and added a short-lived alert for repeat alloc spikes.

lucy: Updating changelog PR noting drained host.

ria: Keeping canary at 12% for remaining pin-ttl. If no other issues, we'll schedule a staged roll tomorrow morning in US-west only. If anomalies increase, we'll consider full rollback.

samir: Agreed. If another host shows alloc spikes, escalate to full rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary stable at 12% after partial drain. Pin-ttl 90m remaining. Reply with "ROLLBACK NOW" to trigger immediate full rollback.

(End of thread)
